owner_decision.statement: The canonical STYNX line remains 1.x and the next unified version is exactly 1.3.0 for the complete 44-package release unit: the Angular 22 line (STYNX 1.3.x per the support policy), the node-redis 6 stores on an explicit RESP2 connection, the vitest 4 runner, and the September 2026 dependency rounds. This supersedes the 2026-09-04 decision naming 1.2.0, which was published on 2026-09-11 and remains the immutable 1.2.x line; the superseded decision is preserved in git history.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified 1.3.0 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.3.0, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history. (The 1.2.0 closure was met on 2026-09-11; the exception is carried forward because 2.0.0 still sits above the canonical line.)
